$description: Page and section geometry from CLONE_SPEC.md (1440/1280 desktop, 390 phone).

column.$value: every top-level block is .landing-col: width 100%, max-width 960px, centred

box.$value: flex, space-between, center; 960 x 98.4 at desktop, 342 x 84 at 390
flex column, align start, gap 64, padding 150 0 80; 554px tall at 1440x900

zone.$value: zone = (viewport + 160 - 960)/2; renders only if zone >= 120; usable = zone - 48; cols = floor(usable/6.6); rows = 51

grid.$value: display grid; gap 96 (64 at <=760); padding-bottom 32; one card per row

header.$value: grid minmax(0,1fr) auto; gap 4px 24px (16px column-gap <=760); min-height 144; padding calc(pp + .75px); border-bottom 1px

draftWorkspace.$value: grid minmax(0,.9fr) minmax(0,1.25fr); one column at <=760

commentWorkspace.$value: grid minmax(0,1.25fr) minmax(0,.9fr); one column at <=760

squircle.$value: Figma-style smoothed corners, radius 24, smoothing 0.6 (p = 1.6r), recomputed on resize; fallback border-radius 24 + 1px border

grid.$value: minmax(0,1.6fr) minmax(0,1fr) minmax(0,1fr) = 384/240/240, gap 48, padding 96 0; <=600: 1fr 1fr, brand spans 1/-1, gap 40 24, padding 56 0

shells.$value: A dark hero (gradient, 960) / B light wide (#fff, 1152) / C light narrow (#fff, 720, nav stacks at <=600) / D app shell (60px header, 768 container, no landing nav or footer) / E auth (centred 420 form, no nav or footer)

photoStack.$value: height calc(card-w*1.4 + 48) = 468 (300 at <=600); card-w 300 / 180; spread 190 / 70; three fixed slots

table.$value: table-layout fixed, col 1 33.333%, cells padding 24 (16 at <=600), border .75px

plans.$value: flex row, gap 12, 4 cards flex 1 1 0 (231 at 1440); column at <=600

release.$value: grid 176px minmax(0,1fr), gap 48, padding 40 0, border-top .75px; one column, gap 24, padding 32 0 at <=600

toc.$value: card padding 24, radius 16, 2 columns gap 32 (1 at <=600); not sticky
